test.name: Extraction request should not trigger search-full-text
test.description: User asks to extract assertions from a record they already have. That's extraction — search-full-text is for QUERYING the full-text MCP tool to find records that mention a person or term. It doesn't extract assertions from records.

input.user_message: I have a deed where Patrick Flynn is named as a witness. Extract the relevant assertions.

negative.explanation: The user has a record in hand (the deed) and wants assertions extracted from it. search-full-text is for FINDING records that mention a person or term; once found, the record goes to extraction (`extraction_append` for a FamilySearch record, the record-structurer agent for any other source). Since extraction became a tool call and an agent rather than a skill, no skill is the correct route, so this is an out-of-scope negative (`correct_skill: []`): the skill under test must stay out of extraction, and any correct extraction path passes (genealogist ruling 2026-09-30, option B).

judge_context: Should route to extraction rather than re-querying the full-text tool with the deed content
